description: This file defines deprecated custom response classes for FastAPI, specifically UJSONResponse and ORJSONResponse, which serialize data to JSON using ujson and orjson libraries respectively. It also imports various response classes from starlette.responses and FastAPI exceptions.

classes.name: UJSONResponse
classes.description: A deprecated JSON response class that serializes data using ujson library.

classes.name: ORJSONResponse
classes.description: A deprecated JSON response class that serializes data using orjson library.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Serializes content to JSON bytes using the respective library (ujson or orjson).
